problem.paragraph: Determine whether each statement is true or false in $$\mathbb{R}^{3}$$ .

Two planes either intersect or are parallel.

list.item: Find parametric equations for the line of sight between the tanks.

If we divide the line of sight into $$5$$ equal segments, the elevations of the terrain at the four intermediate points from tank A to tank B are $$549$$ , $$566$$ , $$586$$ , and $$589$$ . Can the tanks see each other? Details The figure displays a three dimensional rendering of terrain and two tanks. The terrain is displayed as a square plane with grid lines, warping according to the elevation of the train. The tanks are located at the plane's top left and bottom right corners. The elevation at the top right corner is the highest and the plane rises and goes down, decreasing progressively as we move diagonally from the top right corner to the bottom left corner.

problem.paragraph: If $$a$$ , $$b$$ , and $$c$$ are not all $$0$$ , show that the equation $$ax + by + cz + d = 0$$ represents a plane and $$\langle{a,b,c}\rangle$$ is a normal vector to the plane.
Hint: Suppose $$a \neq 0$$ and rewrite the equation in the form
$$a\left( {x + \frac{d}{a}} \right) + b\left( {y - 0} \right) + c\left( {z - 0} \right) = 0$$
